title: Settings not saved
author: zgabi
body_snippet:
Maybe related to #71

- Navigate to File/Options/Tabs&Panels
- Unckeck Keep tabs open after disconnecting
- Press OK

It works until you close the program.

- Close the program
- Open it again

The "Keep tabs open after disconnecting" is checked again.. so it seems that the setting was not saved.

comments.author: zgabi
comments.snippet:
I investigated this issue a little bit.
I install (unzip) the program to C:\Program Files\mRemoteNG folder, and it has no write access to this folder.
Earlier the settings was stored in the user's appdata\Roaming folder.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
@zgabi you nailed it with your investigation — this was exactly the problem! 🎯

## Root Cause

You were right that the settings weren't being saved because of write permissions. Here's what was happening:
